_comment: Editorial content for FHAM. FHAM is a Modaraba — a listed Islamic non-bank financial institution, not an operating industrial company — and the description is written accordingly. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached.
description: First Habib Modaraba (FHM) operates as a non-bank Islamic financial institution — a Modaraba — and describes itself as one of the pioneers of Pakistan's Modaraba sector, with a track record of more than three decades. It is a subsidiary of Habib Metropolitan Bank Limited and was established in 1985. It raises funds through Musharakah-based certificates of investment and deploys them in Shariah-compliant financing, including Diminishing Musharaka, Istisna, car financing and plant and equipment financing.
headOffice: 6th Floor, HBZ Plaza (Hirani Centre), I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://habibmodaraba.com/ (About Us), https://habibmodaraba.com/about-us-2, https://habibmodaraba.com/corporate-information (Board of Directors), https://habibmodaraba.com/contact-us, https://habibmodaraba.com/certificate-of-investment-musharakah-based, https://habibmodaraba.com/diminishing-musharaka and https://habibmodaraba.com/istisna (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Certificate of Investment (Musharakah based)
products.summary: The Modaraba's Musharakah-based investment certificate, offered in tenures from 3 months to 5 years with flexible profit payment plans, to individuals as well as corporate and other concerns.

products.name: Diminishing Musharaka
products.summary: Financing structured on Shirkat-ul-Milk, with joint ownership of the asset, the client purchasing FHM's units over time and profit adjusted to FHM's remaining share.

products.name: FHM Consumer Car Financing
products.summary: Shariah-compliant car financing offered to individual income groups.

products.name: Istisna Financing
products.summary: A sale contract under which FHM undertakes to have the subject matter manufactured or acquired to the customer's specification and sells it at an agreed price and settlement method.

products.name: Plant, machinery, generators and equipment financing
products.summary: Financing for business plant, machinery, generators and equipment.
